chain_words.nuance: connected to the matter being discussed
large enough to have an effect
general sense of high value or weight
absolutely necessary for something to work
decisive, on which everything else depends

explanation: These words all express importance, but they rise from a loose connection to the topic to a decisive level on which everything else depends.

usage_notes.difference: 'Important' describes something of high value in general; 'essential' means something is absolutely necessary, without which something else cannot work.
